title: Privacy Policy
intro: CookMate is a personal project, currently in active development and testing. This policy explains what data the app collects and how it's used — it'll be revised as the app evolves toward a public launch.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.html:
When you create an account, we collect your first name, last name, email address, and a password (stored as a bcrypt hash — we never see or store your actual password).

When you use the app, we store the recipes you create, the recipes you favorite, your eating history (what you marked as eaten and when), and your dietary/cuisine preferences — all tied to your account so the app can show them back to you and personalize recommendations.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.html: Your data is used to operate the app: authenticating you, showing your saved recipes and history, and generating personalized recommendations from your eating history and preferences. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.html:
Optional AI features — smart search, the recipe chat assistant, and AI-assisted recipe drafting — are powered by Google's Gemini API. If you use these features, the text you enter is sent to Google to generate a response. These features are only available to accounts with premium access enabled; if you never use them, nothing is sent to Google on your behalf.

The app's database is hosted on Supabase (a managed PostgreSQL provider), the backend runs on a Contabo VPS, and the frontend is hosted on Vercel.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.html: CookMate doesn't use tracking cookies or third-party analytics. Your login session is a JWT stored in your browser's local storage, used only to authenticate your own requests to the backend.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.html: There's no self-service account deletion yet. If you'd like your account and associated data deleted or exported, email us (below) and we'll handle it manually.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.html: CookMate is not directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect data from them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.html: As the app moves from testing toward a public launch, this policy will be updated to reflect real payment processing, hosting changes, or new features. Material changes will be reflected in the "Last updated" date above.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.html: Questions about this policy or your data? Email atharvadevasthali22@gmail.com.
